# Leonard Vicencio — Social Media Marketing & Management

Leonard Vicencio, also known as Leo Vicencio, is a Philippines-based Social Media Manager and Digital Marketer. He helps local and international brands with social media strategy, content creation, campaign management, community management, analytics, reporting, workflow automation, and practical marketing systems.

## Core methodology

Leonard's Social Photosynthesis Framework explains growth as a connected system: Seed, AA Battery, Roots, Flower, Leads, and Sales. The flower is the engagement stage and the signature visual of the framework.
